summary:
“You are Not Alone” consists of two short stories, illustrating the journeys of two key spacecraft which were discarded on the Moon and deep space. 

a. Journey on the Moon by Eagle (The Descent Stage of LM-5);
b. Astro Reunion by Pioneer 10.

These stories aim to introduce children aged 4 to 12 years old to the space equipment that had made significant impacts to the history of space. The project encourages everyone to think out of the box in coming up with all crazy ideas to bring all our beloved space hardware back to the Earth and bring a new era to space museums. 

These stories are told from the perspectives of Eagle and Pioneer 10. They include works that are executed in space and other spacecraft that are staying in the space currently from interplanetary to interstellar. Through this mechanism, children not only learn about different spacecraft but also explore the ideas of works in space.

The stories use many pictures to make them fun to read and understand. “Journey on the Moon” is illustrated in animation style and emphasis on the works executed on the Moon. While “Astro Reunite” is illustrated in claymation style and emphasis on the different spacecraft in space.

And, some pages in the stories have a link to facts about the missions and equipment deployed. This feature allows readers, especially big kids, to explore more about these subjects. 

Lastly, attempts are made to connect the story to moral lesson as to inspire readers to be resilient in all contexts.
details:
<<You are Not Alone>> is a set of storyboards which build-up from two interactive digital children storylines. The storyboard commemorates  the accomplishments of two spacecraft, named Eagle (descent stage of LM-5) and Pioneer 10, which are still staying in space after their missions were completed.  

This project aims to bring out the work scopes and approaches that were performed by astronauts on the lunar surface in its first storyline <Journey on The Moon> through the perspective of the descend stage LM-5 Eagle. Simultaneously, this project also takes the opportunity to introduce other spacecrafts in space in its second storyline <Astro Reunion> through the perspective of Pioneer 10.

Through its interactive feature, readers could explore and learn some fun facts about the moon, space, spacecraft, works and equipment in space. Nevertheless, the story is also developed from simple picture story to fun fact reading as an add-on at the end of the storyboard. 

From actual journey to inner feeling, the duo-stories not only focus on the factual through storytelling but also attempts to highlight the values of team and friendship regardless of the time and borders. 

The story is deployed via Canva site https://you-are-not-alon.my.canva.site/.

Innovation Highlights

  • Narrative design: Structured in two short stories and illustrated from the perspectives from two left-over equipment in space
  • Educational value: Introduce the works on the lunar surface and other key spacecraft in space along the years.
  • Visual simplicity: Present in two different visuals - cartoon and claymation styles - to enrich the readers’ experience. 
  • Data integrity: References sources from NASA.
